result.stdout:
outwit-controller-pack — package a built controller for WitCloud admin upload.

Usage:
  outwit-controller-pack <module-dir> [options]
  outwit-controller-pack --module <module-dir> [options]

Options:
  --module <dir>           Same as positional argument.
  --output <zip-path>      Output zip path. Default: <Name>-<Version>.zip
                           in the current working directory.
  --allow-external-uris    Permit dataAssets entries with non-file:// URIs.
  -h, --help               Show this help.
